checks.scope: Moment bound underlying the eleven-point reduction
checks.method: Read R15-degree2-independent-ordinary-check.md, Eleven-point support; independently enumerated SF2 graphs with 3–6 edges on six vertices, rejecting vertices of degree at least 3 and three-edge matchings.
checks.observation: Minimum numbers of degree-two vertices are 1,2,4,6, giving local intersecting-pair contributions 5/2,5,8,12. Component structure bounds SF2 support by three times its matching number, so six vertices cover this local domain. The affine majorant 19d/6−7 holds in each case. Conditional on the separately proved minimum used degree 3, I>=60 and total degree 45 yield n<=165/14, hence n<=11; maximum degree 4 would give I<=225/4<60. This checks the moment interface, not the degree-two motif exhaustion.

checks.scope: Tight cover capacity with arbitrary exterior completions
checks.method: Read LOW15-A3-cover-independent-bridge.md and independently reconstructed P8-i2+H5 from literal triples, deleting shifted H5 blocks 014 and 234.
checks.observation: Thirteen triples remain. Direct enumeration gives the sole support three-cover {3,4,11} and eight four-covers containing no three-cover, hence capacity 2+8=10. No pair covers the remaining link; its maximum coverage is 10. Every ambient four-cover therefore contains that three-cover or equals one of the eight support four-covers. Global triple codegree 2 counts all exterior completions. The result contradicts the A3 two-cone requirement of at least 12 actual covers. Only this selected tight case was recalculated.

checks.method: Read the preserved Bucić–He–Lee primary theorem text in general/open01–03.json and assessment.json; independently substituted three petals and the smallest possible support of 68 distinct four-sets.
checks.observation: Theorem 1 gives 3(863/432)^N, with N the support size. Since binomial(7,4)=35, N>=8; already at 8 the displayed bound is 760.9176..., increasing thereafter. The four-coordinate vector expression is 1296D^2 and still depends on alphabet size. These displayed results do not directly imply upper 67.
